A space-separated list of one or more units to which stop requests from this unit shall be propagated to, or units from which stop requests shall be propagated to this unit, respectively.
Configure the optional argument for the reboot(2) system call if `StartLimitAction=` or `FailureAction=` is a reboot action.
A space-separated list of one or more units to which reload requests from this unit shall be propagated to, or units from which reload requests shall be propagated to this unit, respectively.
Similar to `Wants=`, but declares a stronger requirement dependency.
Takes a space-separated list of absolute paths.
A path to a configuration file this unit has been generated from.
Configure an additional action to take if the rate limit configured with `StartLimitIntervalSec=` and `StartLimitBurst=` is hit.
A space-separated list of one or more units to which stop requests from this unit shall be propagated to, or units from which stop requests shall be propagated to this unit, respectively.
Configure the action to take when the unit stops and enters a failed state or inactive state.

Controls the exit status to propagate back to an invoking container manager (in case of a system service) or service manager (in case of a user manager) when the `FailureAction=`/`SuccessAction=` are set to `exit` or `exit-force` and the action is triggered.
Configures dependencies similar to `Wants=`, but as long as this unit is up, all units listed in `Upholds=` are started whenever found to be inactive or failed, and no job is queued for them.
Configures (weak) requirement dependencies on other units.
Same as `RequiresMountsFor=`, but adds dependencies of type `Wants=` instead of `Requires=`.
